about: Owned by the asset agent. Records exactly how kit art is generated and finished, so every batch is made the same way. Fill every field before the next batch; any change to a field bumps profile_version and needs a new style test against the locked anchors. A shared seed alone does not make batches consistent: the model, its version, the reference inputs and their weights, the sampler settings and the finishing steps must all stay the same.
status: to fill in by the asset agent

references.style_reference_input: how the locked anchor renders (assets/painted/_style/anchors/*@4x.png) are supplied, e.g. style-reference image / IP-Adapter / --sref
references.geometry_reference_input: how the piece's layout guide is supplied, e.g. ControlNet canny/depth/lineart or img2img init
references.never_mix: Style references are the approved anchors only. The layout guide is geometry only (canvas, anchor, footprint, height); never let it set colour or style.

finishing.palette_snap_method: every fill snapped to the nearest paint_style.palette tone of the right material (not just the nearest hex overall)
finishing.cleanup: merge islands smaller than ~4 px², smooth jagged contours, keep leaf clusters and planks as whole shapes
finishing.outline_redraw: outer outline #3a2213 at 2.5 canvas px and inner lines #6b4428 at 1.2 px, redrawn as strokes, not traced
finishing.export: SVG with viewBox = canvas, no raster, no gradients/filters/masks/patterns
finishing.normal_map: Laigter: settings to record here; render the final SVG at 2× and save to the entry's `normal`

source_files: Commit the approved pre-trace image as assets/painted/_source/<id>.png (same size as the canvas × 2) so tools/validate-kit.mjs can confirm tracing kept the silhouette and detail.
